metas.name: Long Black A-Type
metas.note: The A-Type long antenna has its highest ridge on the right.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/russia for more clues.

metas.name: Long Black B-Type
metas.note: The B-Type long antenna has its highest ridge on the left.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/russia for more clues.

metas.name: Long Black CA-Type
metas.note: The CA-type long antenna can be thought of as a low A-type or a “twisting antenna” with the ridges being further from the top.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/russia for more clues.

metas.name: Long Black CB-Type
metas.note: The CB-type long antenna can be thought of as a low B-type or a “twisting antenna” with the ridges being further from the top.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/russia for more clues.

metas.name: Long Black Very A-Type
metas.note: The Very A-Type long antenna has a drastically more curved topmost ridge on the right.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/russia for more clues.

metas.name: Long Black Very B-Type
metas.note: The Very B-Type long antenna has a drastically more curved topmost ridge on the left.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/russia for more clues.

metas.name: Long Blurred
metas.note: The blurred long antenna is visibly blurrier than any of the other long antennas.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/russia for more clues.

metas.name: Long Megalong
metas.note: The Megalong antenna has more right ridges (9/10) then a normal long antenna (7/8).

metas.name: Short A-Type
metas.note: The A-type short antenna has its highest ridge on the right.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/russia.

metas.name: Short B-Type
metas.note: The B-type short antenna has its highest ridge on the left
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/russia.

metas.name: Short B-Type Pronounced
metas.note: The B-type pronounced antenna is the same as the B-type antenna but the ridge is more “rectangular”.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/russia.

metas.name: Short Blurred
metas.note: The blurred short antenna is visibly blurrier than any of the other short antennas.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/russia.

metas.name: Short C-Type
metas.note: The C-type short antenna can be thought of as a low A-type or a “twisting antenna” with the ridges being further from the top.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/russia.

metas.name: Short Tilted
metas.note: The tilted short antenna is visibly tilted.
